summary_en: Correction to tender offer completion notice dated 7 July 2026. Kindenelectrical (Kindenelectrical Co., Ltd.) acquired Kodensha shares via public tender offer. Correction: CEO title and name of Kindenelectrical restated in principal shareholder disclosure section.
title_en: (Correction) Partial correction to 'Notice regarding results of public tender offer for shares of our company by Kindenelectrical Co., Ltd. and change in principal shareholders and other related parties'
translation_en_brief: On 7 July 2026, The Kodensha Co., Ltd. issued a correction notice to its prior announcement of 7 July 2026 regarding completion of a public tender offer for its shares conducted by Kindenelectrical Co., Ltd. The correction addresses an error in the name and title of the representative (CEO) of Kindenelectrical within the principal shareholder and related-party disclosure section. The original tender offer was completed, with Kindenelectrical becoming a principal shareholder of Kodensha following acquisition of shares via public tender. Kindenelectrical is a major electrical contractor based in Osaka; as of 31 March 2026, its capital was ¥26.4 billion. The correction clarifies executive nomenclature in the mandatory shareholder-structure update disclosures, with no change to the underlying acquisition terms or shareholding percentage.
